meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne aur oily skin ke liye **₹700 ke andar** kai acche serums available hain jo active acne, clogged pores, aur excess oil ko control karne mein madad karte hain. Sabse behtareen options yeh hain:

Minimalist ka yeh serum pores ke andar jakar **extra oil aur impurities ko dissolve karta hai**, jisse active acne aur blackheads kam hote hain.

Is formula mein 2% Salicylic Acid ke sath **Zinc PCA aur Centella Asiatica** milta hai, jo breakouts ko rokte hain aur redness ko jaldi calm karte hain.

Yeh serum **Cica aur Cactus water** ke infusion ke sath ata hai, jo acne ko treat karne ke sath-sath irritated skin ko deeply soothe karta hai.

Agar aapko active pimples ke bajaye **acne marks (daag-dhabbe)** aur excess oil control karna hai, toh yeh Niacinamide serum ek best option hai.
